newsitem.title: USA: Oshkosh stake cut by Richard Blum group.
newsitem.headline: Oshkosh stake cut by Richard Blum group.

text.p: A group including Richard Blum & Associates said Tuesday it reduced its stake in Oshkosh B'Gosh Inc's outstanding Class A shares to 3.2 percent, or 328,700 shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold the shares after the Oshkosh, Wisconsin, clothing maker offered to purchase up to two million shares at $19 to $22 each.
The group said it sold 657,000 shares in transactions on July 10 and July 14 at $21.75 each.

In the SEC filing, the group said it held shares in the company as an investment. However, it said that in the ordinary course of business it may hold talks with the company representatives and shareholders about enhancing shareholder value.
